description: This is a unit test class for the DefaultIndexInitializationConfig in a MongoDB persistence configuration context within the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains tests for immutability, equality, default values, and reading configuration values.

classes.name: DefaultIndexInitializationConfigTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DefaultIndexInitializationConfig covering immutability, equality, default value behavior, and configuration reading.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by loading a specific configuration file before running tests.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that instances of DefaultIndexInitializationConfig are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods work correctly for DefaultIndexInitializationConfig.

methods.name: underTestReturnsDefaultValuesIfBaseConfigWasEmpty
methods.description: Checks that default values are returned when configuration is empty.

methods.name: underTestReturnsValuesOfConfigFile
methods.description: Checks that configuration values are correctly read from a test config file.
